mapper.select: SELECT role_id, menu_id, permission_type, created_at, updated_at FROM permissions WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT rmp.role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.code AS role_code, rmp.menu_id, m.name AS menu_name, rmp.permission_type AS permission_type, rmp.created_at, rmp.updated_at FROM permissions rmp LEFT JOIN roles r ON rmp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN menus m ON rmp.menu_id = m.menu_id ORDER BY r.id ASC, m.menu_id ASC
